### func ScalarJSONValue

```go
func ScalarJSONValue(v *domain.Value) (any, error)
```

ScalarJSONValue returns a typed JSON-native value for the fixture scalar baseline. Supported: boolean, integer, unsigned, float, visible/mms string, null. Complex encodings (timestamp, bit string, octet string, array, structure) are deferred; they currently return a string interim representation via Value.String().

### type OutputFormat

```go
type OutputFormat int
```

OutputFormat defines structured output formatting (JSON, CSV, Table, YAML, text).

```go
const (
	// OutputFormatText uses human-readable text format (default).
	OutputFormatText OutputFormat = iota
	// OutputFormatJSON uses JSON format.
	OutputFormatJSON
	// OutputFormatCSV uses CSV format.
	OutputFormatCSV
	// OutputFormatTable uses aligned table format.
	OutputFormatTable
	// OutputFormatYAML uses YAML format.
	OutputFormatYAML
)
```

#### func ParseCLIFormat

```go
func ParseCLIFormat(s string) (OutputFormat, error)
```

ParseCLIFormat accepts only text or json. Unknown formats return an error (no silent fallback to text).

#### func ParseOutputFormat

```go
func ParseOutputFormat(s string) (OutputFormat, bool)
```

ParseOutputFormat parses a format string ("json", "csv", "table", "yaml", "text") into OutputFormat. Returns (format, true) on success, or (OutputFormatText, false) for unknown values.

### type Renderer

```go
type Renderer interface {
	RenderLogicalDevices(devices []view.LogicalDevice, w io.Writer) error
	RenderLogicalNodes(nodes []view.LogicalNode, w io.Writer) error
	RenderDataObjects(objects []view.DataObject, w io.Writer) error
	RenderDataAttributes(attrs []view.DataAttribute, w io.Writer) error
	RenderDataSet(ds *view.DataSet, w io.Writer) error
	RenderReportControlBlock(rcb *view.ReportControlBlock, w io.Writer) error
}
```

Renderer defines the contract for rendering view projections in a specific output format. Each output format (JSON, CSV, Table, YAML, Text) implements this interface. Renderers only accept view types — never domain types.

#### func NewRenderer

```go
func NewRenderer(format OutputFormat) Renderer
```

NewRenderer returns a Renderer for the given output format.
